# Omnimo vs ChatOn

Updated November 25, 2026 · prices from the US App Store

ChatOn, from AIBY, is one of the most popular AI chat apps on the App Store, with 289,000 ratings. Omnimo is much newer. Both offer more than one model; they differ in what they are built around.

## Side by side

|  | Omnimo | ChatOn |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Made by | An independent developer | AIBY |
| Models | GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM and MiniMax: from several makers, switchable mid-chat, plus Apple Intelligence on the device | GPT-5, Gemini 3.5, Claude Sonnet 5 and Sonar, as its listing names them |
| Price (US) | Free; Omnimo Pro $6.99 a week (3-day trial), $9.99 a month, $39.99 a year (1-week trial) | Premium at $6.99 and $7.99 (weekly) and $29.99 and $39.99 (in-app purchase list) |
| Free to start | Unlimited Apple Intelligence on the device; a few messages a day with GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, DeepSeek V4 Flash and Qwen 3.8 Flash; one image a day | Free download |
| On-device model | Apple Intelligence, free, unlimited and offline (iOS, iPadOS or macOS 26 on a supported device) | Not in its listing |
| What the listing highlights | photos the model can see, documents read on the device, Ask Web with sources, image and video generation, your own assistants, voice, Siri and Shortcuts, a widget, 46 languages, no account | 100+ ready prompts, image and video generation, text from photos, web search, PDF summaries, YouTube summaries, math help |
| App Store rating | New: one rating on the US App Store when we checked | 4.7 from 289,000 ratings (US App Store, 25 November 2026) |

Omnimo: the app's App Store listing and its pricing (US). ChatOn: its App Store listing and list of in-app purchases, US storefront, read 25 November 2026. Prices in other countries differ.

## Where ChatOn is better

ChatOn has a large library of ready prompts (100+), YouTube video summaries, an AI keyboard, and image and video generation from photos. It has years of reviews behind it and is rated 4.7.

## Where Omnimo is better

Omnimo names every model and lets you pick: GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and more, switchable mid-chat. Apple Intelligence on the device is free and unlimited, and documents are read on the device. Pro has a monthly plan at $9.99 besides the weekly and yearly ones.

## The honest verdict

**Choose ChatOn** if you want ready prompts, YouTube summaries and an AI keyboard.

**Choose Omnimo** if you want to choose the model yourself, a free on-device model and a monthly plan.

Both are free to try: [ChatOn on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1661308505) and [Omnimo on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891). Omnimo is made by the team that writes this site, so weigh this page accordingly; we have tried to say where ChatOn wins.

## Questions

### Which models does ChatOn use?

Its App Store listing says it is built on GPT-5, Gemini 3.5, Claude Sonnet 5 and Sonar. Omnimo lists GPT-6, Claude (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable), Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM and MiniMax.

### How much is ChatOn compared with Omnimo?

ChatOn's in-app purchases include Premium at $6.99 and $7.99 a week and at $29.99 and $39.99 (25 November 2026). Omnimo Pro is $6.99 a week, $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year in the US.

### Does Omnimo have a prompt library?

Yes, on this site: the [prompt library](https://www.privateslm.dev/prompts/) has ready prompts to copy into Omnimo.
